environment: isolated GitHub Actions Docker Compose test stack
scope: read-only GET requests: 80% /api/rooms/ and 20% /rooms/; no authenticated booking writes
limitations: The average RPS is calculated over the complete ramp-up, plateau and ramp-down profile.
This is a virtual-user session test, not 1000 simultaneous in-flight HTTP requests.
It does not validate concurrent booking writes, long-duration mixed workloads, production Render capacity or host-specific CPU/RAM sizing.
